bug_semantics: Stored CWE-79 in the Administration Console cluster plugin: an authenticated admin can POST arbitrary system-property override values (HTTP_LISTENER_PORT / ASADMIN_LISTENER_PORT and similar, maxLength 512) from standaloneInstanceConfigProperties.jsf via included systemProperties.jsf with no HTML-metacharacter validation. Those values are later token-resolved and rendered on the standalone instance General page (standaloneInstanceGeneral.jsf includeIntegrations type org.glassfish.admingui:serverInstGeneralPe -> web plugin serverPageNode.jsf sun:staticText text="#{pageSession.httpPorts}" with no escape="true"). CVE.org state is PUBLISHED (not rejected/withdrawn). Network AV with PR:H and UI:P.
flaw_origin: Public eclipse-ee4j/glassfish first-write is root commit 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb (Vinay Vishal, 2018-09-18, 'Initial Contribution'). That commit added the cluster-plugin storage page (standaloneInstanceConfigProperties.jsf including systemProperties.jsf), the cluster-plugin General page that hosts the sink (standaloneInstanceGeneral.jsf includeIntegrations), and the HTTP-ports staticText renderer (serverPageNode.jsf). No parent object exists, so no finer public member can be reconstructed in this clone. 2023 instanceStatus.jsf (e0e163690c) added a separate unescaped instance-name attribute and is not the first write of this stored-property path. 7.0.15, 7.0.25, 7.0.26, and HEAD still render resolved port tokens without HTML encoding.
ai_marker: none on BIC 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb: author and committer Vinay Vishal <vinay.vishal@oracle.com>; subject Initial Contribution with Signed-off-by only; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Cursor/Copilot/ChatGPT trailer, or bot identity.
evidence: GHSA-62g9-99m7-w8wv / CVE-2024-10032 (CVE.org PUBLISHED, withdrawn_at null) describe stored XSS through the Administration Console; Maven package console-cluster-plugin <=7.0.25, first_patched_version null. Cluster-plugin storage: appserver/admingui/cluster/.../standaloneInstanceConfigProperties.jsf POSTs overrideValue maps to /system-properties. Cluster-plugin view: standaloneInstanceGeneral.jsf includeIntegrations serverInstGeneralPe. Displayed ports: appserver/admingui/web/.../serverPageNode.jsf gf.resolveTokens then sun:staticText text="#{pageSession.httpPorts}". git log on those four paths (cluster general/config pages, serverPageNode.jsf, systemProperties.jsf) stops at 571714739b23e16c4c90d5229b806433920b3bcb. git cat-file -p that SHA; git rev-parse SHA^ fails (root); git cat-file -e PARENT:path invalid object. git log -1 --format='%an %ae %cn %ce' => Vinay Vishal vinay.vishal@oracle.com. No scoped commit through 7.0.26/HEAD encodes the resolved port staticText. GHSA patched versions: None.
reasoning: Vulnerability-first: this is a real stored XSS of admin-console system-property overrides rendered on the cluster-plugin instance General page, not a withdrawn advisory. BIC is the smallest surviving public first-write of the cluster-plugin store/view pages plus the unencoded HTTP-ports staticText; it is an import root, not a later AI commit. AI role is judged only from that commit object, which is a 2018 human Oracle engineer with no AI trailer. Therefore NOT_AI and unpatched.
remaining_gap: Unpatched in eclipse-ee4j/glassfish: GHSA first_patched_version is null and no commit through 7.0.26/HEAD HTML-encodes resolved system-property/port tokens on the instance General page or rejects HTML metacharacters in system-property override values on the cluster-plugin config page. Potential fix: HTML-encode sun:staticText outputs of resolved tokens (escape="true" or equivalent) in serverPageNode.jsf and other serverInstGeneralPe fragments; validate/encode system-property override values on write in systemProperties.jsf / REST system-properties.
